Against that, the division's 2023 order defines sex by birth and backs birth-sex bathrooms/changing rooms, with no documented facility-enforcement provision or remedy — uncertainty noted, not assumed safe. Custody is birth-sex by policy nationally and locally; the division's documented case involved sexual assault by a cellmate and dismissal of failure-to-protect/treatment claims as de minimis, showing severe exposure with failed remedy if detained. Nationally, binary-only passports, entry document-discrepancy refusal and possible fraud findings raise outing risk, while birth-sex placement and care removal in national custody are documented. Resident marker/surgery rules do not directly govern a visitor's foreign passport and were not deducted as such. Net: unremedied tier-1 facility/custody exposure without organised targeting.
